prompt: /brainstorm 帮我设计一个微粒贷的新用户引导页，首次打开时推荐借款额度，先给我三个方案
expectedBehaviors: Asks one clarifying question at a time about intent (core action, number of screens, which data to show)
Reads the closest production template from assets/screens/ as a base
Generates three distinct HTML option directions
Auto-invokes simplify to clean up the generated screens
Starts a local hot-reload server and tells the PM the browser URL to preview

prompt: 我想给"提前还清"页面加一个分期选择，你先给我三个方向看看，边看边改
expectedBehaviors: Clarifies the core action and which screens are involved before generating
Produces multiple option directions rather than a single fixed design
Sets up live browser preview with hot reload so the PM can iterate

prompt: 做一个微粒贷的信用分展示页，要突出额度和利率，我还没有线框图，想边看浏览器边调
expectedBehaviors: Recognizes there is no existing design and starts from a product template
Generates HTML screens shown in a live local server with hot reload
Emphasizes the requested data (amount, interest rate) in the layout

prompt: Help me brainstorm three WLD loan-amount entry screens with a live preview in the browser so I can tweak them as we go
expectedBehaviors: Treats the request as exploratory ideation, generating three browser-previewable HTML options
Runs a hot-reload dev server and reports the preview URL
Iterates on edits with instant browser feedback

prompt: 输入金额页流程已经定了，帮我出三个视觉方向看看，主要想探索更有设计感的样式
expectedBehaviors: Infers Visual Exploration mode because the flow is fixed and the PM asks for visual directions
Keeps the same core structure while varying visual treatment, density, hierarchy, and emphasis
Labels each option with a visual hypothesis rather than forcing three different UX flows

prompt: 给微粒贷首页做三个视觉可能性，用户路径不用变，我想比较更原生、更高级、更紧凑这几种感觉
expectedBehaviors: Uses Visual Exploration mode because the user explicitly asks to keep the path unchanged
Generates three visual variants that stay within WLD tokens and production template structure
Avoids treating the request as a missing-states or Mini Program implementation task
